takeaways: Copied datasets and one-off DAX tweaks create spreadmart chaos and technical debt, so the same metric ends up with several competing definitions.
Microsoft Fabric puts a centrally managed semantic model at the center, so finance, marketing and operations build their own reports on one shared set of definitions.
Calculation groups shrink measure sprawl and row-level security defined in the model keeps self-service BI flexible without exposing sensitive data.
hook: Copy-pasted Power BI datasets slowly turn quick wins into conflicting numbers and long-term data debt. This episode shows BI teams and data architects how reusable semantic models in Microsoft Fabric, calculation groups and row-level security create one trusted source of truth that still supports self-service reporting.
